'''Larry Lim''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Columbus tournament (24 March)]] on 24 March 2001 with Executor Holotheatre start, according to Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1949">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01d1949/ turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 25 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01d1949/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
